title: Pocketwire Advance Card Repayment Amount — Calculation Note
content:
What a Pocketwire Advance line owes is the principal disbursed and the fees booked on it less its repayments and waivers. The card repayment share is 30 percent. The card repayment is what the line owes multiplied by the card repayment share, rounded to the cent (half up), at least the tier's smallest manual repayment and never more than what the line owes.

## Quantities

- **What the line owes** — the total of every advance disbursed and every fee booked on the line, less the total of every repayment and every fee waiver on it, taken to the cent.
- **The card repayment share** — 30 percent of what the line owes.
- **The card repayment** — what the line owes multiplied by 30 percent and rounded to the cent (half up); where that figure is below the tier's smallest manual repayment it is raised to it, and in no case is it more than what the line owes.

## Worked figures (hypothetical lines, smallest manual repayment 5.00)

| What the line owes | Multiplied by 30 percent | Card repayment |
|---|---|---|
| 157.50 | 47.25 | 47.25 |
| 101.25 | 30.375 | 30.38 (half rounded up) |
| 12.00 | 3.60 | 5.00 — raised to the smallest manual repayment |
| 4.00 | 1.20 | 4.00 — raised to 5.00, then held to what the line owes |

## What the line owes, worked (hypothetical)

A line with 300.00 of advances disbursed, 14.00 of fees booked, 120.00 of repayments and 1.00 of waivers owes 193.00; its card repayment is 57.90.
